# Contributing to Gravital Shots

Thank you for considering contributing! Here are a few basic guidelines to follow.

## Workflow & Branches

- Work on a separate feature branch: `feature/your-feature-name` or `fix/your-fix-name`.
- Keep commits small and descriptive.

## Pull Requests

- Open a PR against the `main` branch.
- Ensure the project builds without errors before submitting.
- Follow existing C# naming conventions and formatting.
